Youthful soft features, round thin wire spectacles, a gentle curious expression. Soft wavy brown hair of medium length, loosely tucked behind the ears and reaching the collar. A long pale linen work dust coat, open, worn over a grey knitted pullover and a white shirt collar, dark trousers, plain flat shoes, a pencil in the coat's breast pocket, a faint blue ink mark on one finger. Fictional and generic: must not resemble any identifiable real person.
One wide character turnaround sheet on a plain flat mid-grey background: the same man standing full length four times side by side at the same scale, front view, three-quarter view, side profile and back view, neutral relaxed standing pose with arms down, even flat studio light from the front with no cast shadows, so that silhouette and clothing read clearly.
Reminder of the medium: A digital character concept painting for a modern story-driven 3D game: realistic proportions and anatomy, slightly softened and simplified painted surfaces, clear readable shapes, crisp tailoring with sculpted cloth folds, restrained natural colour.
Avoid: text, letters, labels, captions, watermarks, logos, UI, borders or frames; anime, cartoon, chibi or caricature proportions; fantasy or steampunk costume; anachronistic clothing, modern eyewear or modern hairstyles; dramatic lighting, heavy shadows or vignettes; extra or warped hands and fingers; different people in different views.
